keyCharacteristics: Charcoal and roof green from the logo, on white and warm stone.
Montserrat 800 uppercase headings echoing the logo's lettering; Source Sans 3 for reading.
A short green double rule under headings, taken from the rules either side of ROOFING in the logo.
Hairline-ruled grids instead of shadowed cards.
Solid charcoal panels over photos, never a full-image wash.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Rule
rules.body: No colour enters the UI that is not in the logo or a neutral. The hero's orange belongs to the photograph and is never sampled.

rules.name: The Light-Ground Logo Rule
rules.body: The logo is charcoal on transparent and only ever sits on white or stone: never on charcoal, green or a photo.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Headings are always heavy uppercase Montserrat; tracking opens only on small labels, as with the logo's spaced ROOFING.
